label: sdc01_0210_sister_01
text: There you are, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c\nJust because we didn’t agree to meet doesn’t\nmean you get to keep me waiting![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0210_sister_02
text: So, uh, y’see...I wanted to talk to you a bit.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0210_sister_03
text: You haven’t told anybody about the, y’know...\nthe thing that happened yesterday? Right?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0210_sister_04
text: You better not be lying! If I find out you blabbed,\nI’m gonna make you swallow a Koffing whole![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0210_sister_05
text: Come on—you know exactly what I’m talking\nabout! We bumped into the oguuur...t. Yogurt.\r\nYes, yogurt! So don’t play dumb, got it?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0210_sister_06
text: You still have that thing we picked up at the\nstairs, right?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0210_sister_07
text: My grandpa knows a lot about the village’s\nhistory. We should go talk to him about what\r\nhappened yesterday![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0210_sister_08
text: You know where my house is, right? See you\nthere. Don’t keep me waiting.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0210_sister_09
text: Let’s show Grandpa the...y’know...the thing\nwe found.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0210_student1_01
text:
I’ve only been able to visit one sign! Carmine’s
just nowhere to be found!\c
The way she marches to the beat of her own
drum sure is something, though...

label: sdc01_0210_student2_01
text: Kieran’s pretty shy, huh? Though he seems to\nhave opened up to you.

label: sdc01_0210_student3_01
text: The humid heat is still bugging me, but I’ve\ngotten used to being around bug Pokémon!

label: sdc01_0210_caretaker_01
text: The Festival of Masks will go on for a while, so\nplease enjoy it to your heart’s content![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
